docs.title: BlinkLearn
docs.text: BlinkLearn is your AI-native personal learning platform — one place that brings together everything you learn across courses, classrooms, meditations, and events, and intelligently connects it to what matters right now.

docs.title: What BlinkLearn does
docs.text:
• Aggregates your learning — courses, classrooms, meditations, notes, and insights all in one place
  • Surfaces the right thing — your AI companion Sandra knows your learning history and brings relevant knowledge to you
  • Builds on itself — every session adds to your memory, making Sandra smarter about what you need next
  • Works across surfaces — web and mobile, so you learn wherever you are

docs.text:

docs.title: Deleting Your Account
docs.text: Deleting your BlinkLearn account permanently removes your profile, learning history, notes, and AI memories. This cannot be undone.

docs.title: Before you delete
docs.text:
• Download any notes or pages you want to keep
  • Note that deleting your account may also affect your access to other Envisioning products if they share the same identity

docs.title: How to delete
docs.text:
1. Go to your profile settings
  2. Scroll to the bottom of the page
  3. Click Delete account
  4. Confirm by entering your email address

Your account will be scheduled for deletion. If you change your mind, contact support within 7 days.

docs.title: Contact support
docs.text: If you need help with your account or are unsure about deletion, contact the support team before proceeding.

docs.title: Password Reset
docs.text:
1. Go to blinklearn.com and click Log in
  2. Click Forgot password?
  3. Enter the email address on your account
  4. Check your email for a reset link — it expires after 30 minutes
  5. Click the link and choose a new password

docs.title: No email arrived?
docs.text:
• Check your spam or junk folder
  • Make sure you entered the correct email address
  • Allow a few minutes before requesting a second link

docs.title: Signed up with Google?
docs.text: If you created your account with Google, there is no BlinkLearn password to reset. Sign in with Google and manage your password through your Google account settings.

docs.title: Profile & Settings
docs.text: Go to your profile by clicking your avatar in the sidebar or navigating to blinklearn.com/profile.

docs.title: What you can update
docs.text:
• Display name — how your name appears to other learners and authors
  • Username (handle) — your unique BlinkLearn handle, used for shared notes and your public profile
  • Profile photo — your avatar shown across BlinkLearn
  • Email address — the email associated with your account

docs.title: AI companion settings
docs.text: To personalise Sandra, go to My AI.

docs.title: Notification preferences
docs.text: Control which emails and in-app notifications you receive from the Settings section of your profile page.

docs.title: Signing In
docs.text: Go to blinklearn.com and click Log in.

docs.title: Sign-in methods
docs.text:
• Email and password — enter the email and password you registered with
  • Google — click Continue with Google and select your Google account

docs.title: Shared credentials across Envisioning
docs.text: If you use BlinkLife or another Envisioning product with the same email, your credentials work on BlinkLearn too. Your AI memory and learning history are shared across the Envisioning ecosystem.

docs.title: Staying signed in
docs.text: BlinkLearn keeps you signed in on trusted devices. If you are signed out unexpectedly, check that cookies are enabled in your browser.

docs.title: Problems signing in?
docs.text: See Login Issues or reset your password.

docs.title: Billing & Plans
docs.text: BlinkLearn is available on subscription plans that unlock different levels of content and AI features. Plan details and pricing are shown inside the app under your account settings.

docs.title: Managing your subscription
docs.text: To view or change your plan, go to your profile settings and look for the Subscription section.

docs.title: Cancelling
docs.text: You can cancel your subscription at any time. You'll retain access to your plan's features until the end of your current billing period.

docs.title: Questions about billing?
docs.text: For billing-specific questions, contact the support team directly via the in-app support option.

docs.title: Chat with Sandra
docs.text: Sandra is your personal AI learning companion. She knows everything you've learned on BlinkLearn and can help you make sense of it, connect ideas, and go deeper on any topic.

docs.title: Starting a conversation
docs.text:
Go to Chat in the sidebar to open a conversation with Sandra. You can ask her anything:

  • "What have I learned about leadership this month?"
  • "Summarise the key ideas from the fasting course"
  • "What meditations have I done recently?"
  • "Connect what I learned in the last classroom to my goal of improving focus"

Sandra has access to your full learning history — lessons completed, notes taken, insights generated — so her answers are grounded in what you've actually studied.

docs.title: Memory-powered responses
docs.text:
Unlike a general AI, Sandra's responses are personalised to you. She draws from:

  • Your lessons — content from every course and classroom you've engaged with
  • Your notes — smart notes you've taken during sessions
  • Your insights — AI-generated connections from your learning history
  • Your goals — the areas you've told BlinkLearn you want to grow in

docs.title: Conversation history
docs.text: Sandra remembers your previous conversations. You can refer back to earlier discussions and she'll maintain context across sessions.

docs.title: Tips for getting the most from Sandra
docs.text:
• Ask open-ended questions ("What patterns do you notice in what I've been learning?")
  • Ask for connections ("How does what I learned in X relate to Y?")
  • Ask for recommendations ("What should I study next based on my goals?")

docs.title: Classrooms
docs.text: Classrooms are structured learning experiences created by teachers, coaches, and experts on BlinkLearn. They combine live sessions, content, and direct access to the author.

docs.title: Types of classrooms
docs.text:
• Live classrooms — scheduled sessions you attend in real time with the author and other learners
  • Async classrooms — self-paced content you work through on your own schedule

docs.title: Joining a classroom
docs.text: When you enrol in a classroom, it appears in your Classrooms section. Your progress and any notes you take are saved and fed into Sandra's understanding of your learning.

docs.title: Classroom briefings
docs.text: For active classrooms, Sandra generates briefings — summaries of what's happened in the classroom and what's coming next. These appear in your Today view.

docs.title: Interacting with the author
docs.text: Some classrooms include Q&A or feedback features where you can interact with the teacher directly. Check the classroom detail page for what's available.

docs.title: Courses
docs.text: The Courses section is where you access all the on-demand learning content available to you on BlinkLearn.

docs.title: Browsing courses
docs.text: Go to Courses in the sidebar to see your enrolled courses and browse the catalog. Each course card shows the title, author, and your progress if you've started.

docs.title: Inside a course
docs.text:
Click a course to open it. Inside, you'll find:

  • Lessons — individual video or text lessons you work through in sequence
  • Author information — who created the course and their background
  • Your progress — how far through the course you are

docs.title: Completing lessons
docs.text: Click a lesson to start it. Your progress is saved automatically — you can pick up where you left off at any time. Each lesson you complete feeds into Sandra's understanding of your learning history.

docs.title: Course notes
docs.text: While inside a lesson, you can take notes that are automatically linked to that lesson. Find them later in your Notes or Library.

docs.title: Goals
docs.text: Goals let you tell BlinkLearn what you want to achieve — and Sandra uses this to shape your daily briefing, recommendations, and insights.

docs.title: Setting a goal
docs.text:
Go to Goals in the sidebar and add a new goal. Describe what you want to learn or achieve — for example:

  • "Become a better communicator"
  • "Build a daily meditation habit"
  • "Understand the fundamentals of leadership"

Goals can be as broad or specific as you like.

docs.title: How Sandra uses your goals
docs.text:
Sandra incorporates your goals into everything she does:

  • Your Today briefing highlights learning that connects to your goals
  • Insights surface connections relevant to your goal areas
  • Chat responses are framed in terms of what you're trying to achieve

docs.title: Updating goals
docs.text: Your goals evolve as you grow. Update or remove goals at any time — Sandra will adjust immediately.

docs.title: Insights
docs.text: Insights are AI-generated connections that BlinkLearn surfaces across everything you've learned — linking ideas from different courses, classrooms, and meditations that relate to each other.

docs.title: What insights are
docs.text:
Sandra continuously analyses your learning history and extracts patterns, recurring themes, and connections between ideas from different sources. These surface as Insights — short, actionable observations like:

  • "This concept from your leadership course connects to what you explored in the fasting module"
  • "Three of your recent sessions touched on the idea of intentional focus — here's a synthesis"

docs.title: Browsing your insights
docs.text: Go to Insights in the sidebar to see all insights Sandra has generated for you. They're organised by recency and relevance.

docs.title: How insights are generated
docs.text:
Sandra generates insights automatically as you:

  • Complete lessons and courses
  • Take notes
  • Chat with her about your learning

You don't need to do anything — insights appear as your learning grows.

docs.title: Using insights
docs.text: Insights are a starting point for deeper exploration. Click any insight to see the connected content and jump back into the relevant lesson or note.

docs.title: Library
docs.text: Your Library is your personal collection of saved content on BlinkLearn — courses, classrooms, notes, and anything else you've bookmarked or want to return to.

docs.title: What's in your Library
docs.text:
• Courses you're enrolled in
  • Classrooms you've joined
  • Notes you've created
  • Content you've saved or bookmarked

docs.title: Accessing your Library
docs.text: Go to Library in the sidebar to see all your saved content in one place. Use the filters to browse by content type.

docs.title: Continuing where you left off
docs.text: Your progress on any course or classroom is saved. Open it from the Library to pick up exactly where you stopped.

docs.title: Listener
docs.text: Listener is BlinkLearn's hands-free audio mode — it reads your learning content aloud so you can learn while doing other things.

docs.title: Using Listener
docs.text:
Go to Listener in the sidebar and select the content you want to listen to. Listener works with:

  • Course lessons
  • Classroom content
  • Your notes and pages

Press play and BlinkLearn reads the content aloud. Use the playback controls to pause, skip, or adjust speed.

docs.title: Offline and background playback
docs.text: Listener continues playing in the background while you use other apps. On mobile, you can lock your screen and audio keeps playing.

docs.title: Learning on the go
docs.text: Listener is designed for commutes, walks, and any time you want to learn without a screen. Your progress is tracked the same as if you were reading — completed content feeds into Sandra's memory.

docs.title: Meditations
docs.text: BlinkLearn includes a library of guided meditations that integrate with your learning practice.

docs.title: Browsing meditations
docs.text: Go to Meditations in the sidebar to browse the catalog. Meditations are organised by theme, duration, and purpose.

docs.title: Starting a meditation
docs.text: Click a meditation to open the player. Sessions range from a few minutes to longer practices. Your completed meditations are tracked and visible to Sandra — she can incorporate them into your briefings and recommendations.

docs.title: Meditations and your learning
docs.text: Sandra treats meditations as part of your holistic learning practice. If you regularly meditate on focus or creativity, she takes that into account when connecting ideas and making recommendations in Chat and Insights.

docs.title: Scheduling meditations
docs.text: You can schedule a meditation to appear in your Today agenda. Use the scheduling option on any meditation card to add it to a specific day.

docs.title: Memories
docs.text: Memories are everything Sandra has learned about you through your learning activity — the building blocks of her personalised responses.

docs.title: What memories contain
docs.text:
As you use BlinkLearn, Sandra builds up a picture of:

  • Topics and themes you engage with repeatedly
  • Ideas you've noted as important
  • Connections she's made between different pieces of content
  • Your stated goals and preferences

These are stored as memories and surface in Chat, Insights, and your Today briefing.

docs.title: Viewing your memories
docs.text: Go to Memories in the sidebar to see what Sandra has stored. Each memory entry shows the source content and what Sandra learned from it.

docs.title: Managing memories
docs.text: You can delete individual memory entries if you want Sandra to forget something. This affects future responses but does not affect your learning history or notes.

docs.title: My AI
docs.text:
My AI is where you personalise your AI companion Sandra — her name, voice, personality, and how she understands you. Open it from the sidebar.

My AI has three tabs: Personality, Profile, and My Human.

docs.title: Personality tab
docs.text:
The Personality tab controls how Sandra behaves in conversation. It has two modes:

  • Structured — set a named archetype (e.g. Friend, Coach, Mentor) that drives Sandra's communication style
  • Soul.md — write free-form instructions in markdown for full control over her tone and behaviour

docs.title: Archetype
docs.text: Choose one of the preset archetypes as Sandra's baseline character. Each archetype comes with a set of default communication rules. Click Change to switch to a different archetype.

docs.title: How Sandra Communicates
docs.text: A list of editable rules that govern Sandra's style — things like tone, humour, and how she handles feedback. Rules are tagged with the archetype they came from. You can add custom rules with + Add or delete any rule individually.

docs.title: Learned Adaptations
docs.text: Sandra picks up patterns from your conversations automatically and stores them here. These are distinct from rules you set manually — they reflect how Sandra has naturally adapted to you over time.

docs.title: Boundaries
docs.text: Rules about what Sandra won't do, regardless of archetype. Use this to set hard limits on topics or behaviour.

docs.title: Custom Instructions
docs.text: Free-form text that Sandra always considers, regardless of the active archetype. Use this for context that doesn't fit into a specific rule.

docs.title: Profile tab
docs.text: The Profile tab controls Sandra's identity and voice.

docs.title: Identity
docs.text: Set Sandra's name and avatar. The name appears throughout the app and in chat. Change it to anything that feels right for you.

docs.title: Voice
docs.text:
Choose how Sandra sounds in voice mode. Six options are available:

Voice Style Zara Confident and direct Mia Bright and articulate Lena Gentle and conversational Kai Energetic and expressive Leo Deep and unhurried Theo Grounded and clear

Click the play button next to any voice to preview it, then click Save Changes.

docs.title: My Human tab
docs.text:
The My Human tab shows Sandra's model of you — a structured summary of what she has learned about you from your conversations, notes, and learning history.

Click Generate Profile to have Sandra produce this summary. If no profile exists yet, she will build one from your existing memories.

You can view the full memory list that feeds into this profile by clicking View all memories →, which takes you to Memories.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text: Notes let you capture ideas, reflections, and key takeaways as you learn. BlinkLearn notes are smart — Sandra links them to the content they came from and uses them to build your learning memory.

docs.title: Creating a note
docs.text: Go to Notes in the sidebar and click New note, or take notes directly inside a lesson or classroom session. Notes taken inside content are automatically linked to that lesson.

docs.title: Note types
docs.text:
• Free-form notes — write anything, anytime
  • In-lesson notes — captured while a lesson is active, linked to the specific lesson

docs.title: Smart linking
docs.text: Sandra reads your notes as part of your learning history. When you ask her a question in Chat, she can reference relevant notes. Your notes also contribute to Insights — Sandra may surface connections between note content and other things you've learned.

docs.title: Sharing notes
docs.text: Notes can be shared via a public link. Go to the note and use the share option to generate a link that others can view.

docs.title: Pages
docs.text: Pages are AI-powered documents you can create and edit in BlinkLearn. Sandra can help you draft, expand, and organise content — useful for capturing and synthesising what you've learned.

docs.title: Creating a page
docs.text: Go to Pages in the sidebar and click New page. Start typing or ask Sandra to help you draft content based on your learning history.

docs.title: Collaborating with Sandra
docs.text:
Inside a page, you can ask Sandra to:

  • Draft a summary of a topic you've been studying
  • Expand on a note or idea
  • Organise bullet points into a structured document

docs.title: Sharing pages
docs.text: Pages can be shared with other BlinkLearn users or via a public link. Use the share option at the top of any page to manage access.

docs.title: Use cases
docs.text:
• Synthesising key takeaways from a course
  • Creating a personal study guide
  • Drafting a reflection after a classroom session

docs.title: Skills
docs.text: Skills are capabilities you can activate to enhance what Sandra can do for you. Each skill extends Sandra's understanding or adds a new type of interaction.

docs.title: Browsing skills
docs.text: Go to Skills in the sidebar to see available skills. Each skill card describes what it does and how to activate it.

docs.title: Activating a skill
docs.text: Click a skill card and follow the activation steps. Once active, the skill is available in your Chat with Sandra. You can deactivate skills at any time from the same page.

docs.title: Examples of skills
docs.text:
Skills can help Sandra:

  • Connect your learning to specific frameworks or methods
  • Provide more structured summaries after lessons
  • Track specific types of progress you care about

The skills catalog grows over time as new capabilities are added.

docs.title: Today
docs.text: The Today view is your personalised daily learning briefing, prepared by Sandra each morning.

docs.title: What you'll find
docs.text:
• Morning briefing — a digest of your recent learning activity, key takeaways, and anything Sandra thinks is worth revisiting
  • Your agenda — upcoming lessons, classrooms, and meditations scheduled for today
  • Proactive suggestions — Sandra's recommendations based on your goals and what you've been working on

docs.title: How it's generated
docs.text:
Sandra draws from everything she knows about you: completed lessons, notes you've taken, insights from your content, and your stated learning goals. Each day's briefing is unique to your learning journey.

The briefing refreshes overnight. Open BlinkLearn in the morning to see what Sandra has prepared.

docs.title: Taking action from Today
docs.text: Click any item in the agenda to jump directly into a lesson or classroom. Sandra's suggestions link directly to the content she's recommending.

docs.title: Getting Started with BlinkLearn
docs.text: Welcome to BlinkLearn. These guides will help you get set up and make the most of your AI learning companion.

docs.title: Steps
docs.text:
1. Creating Your Account — sign up and set up your profile
  2. Understanding Today — your daily briefing and agenda

Already have an account? Go straight to signing in.

docs.title: Sign up
docs.text:
Go to blinklearn.com and click Get started or Sign up.

You can create an account with:

  • Email and password — enter your email, choose a password, and verify your email address
  • Google — sign in with your existing Google account for a faster setup

docs.title: Onboarding
docs.text:
After creating your account, BlinkLearn walks you through a short setup:

  1. Your role — tell us how you learn best
  2. Your companion — choose a name and style for your AI companion
  3. Your handle — pick a unique username for your public profile
  4. Your goals — select the learning areas you want to focus on

This helps Sandra personalise your experience from day one.

docs.title: Shared identity across Envisioning
docs.text: If you already use another Envisioning product (BlinkLife, Finerminds), your account and AI memory are shared. You can sign in to BlinkLearn with the same credentials.

docs.title: Next steps
docs.text:

docs.title: Understanding Your Today View
docs.text: The Today view is your home base in BlinkLearn — a personalised morning briefing that Sandra prepares for you each day.

docs.title: What's on Today
docs.text:
• Morning briefing — Sandra summarises your recent learning and surfaces relevant insights based on what you've been studying
  • Daily agenda — your scheduled lessons, classrooms, and meditations for the day
  • Proactive nudges — Sandra's suggestions for what to pick up next based on your goals and learning history

The briefing refreshes daily. If you open BlinkLearn early in the morning, Sandra has already prepared a summary of yesterday's highlights and what's relevant today.

docs.title: Personalisation
docs.text:
The more you learn and interact with Sandra, the more relevant your Today view becomes. Sandra tracks:

  • Lessons you've completed
  • Notes you've taken
  • Insights generated from your content
  • Your stated goals

All of this feeds into a richer daily briefing over time.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• Chat & Sandra Issues
  • Login Issues
  • Course & Content Issues

docs.title: Sandra isn't responding
docs.text:
• Check your internet connection
  • Refresh the page and try again
  • If the issue persists, try signing out and back in

docs.title: Sandra's answers don't seem relevant to my learning
docs.text:
Sandra's responses improve as your learning history grows. If you're new to BlinkLearn, she has less context to draw from. Try:

  • Completing a few lessons first
  • Taking notes as you learn
  • Telling Sandra directly what you're focused on (e.g. "I'm studying leadership — what have I covered so far?")

docs.title: Sandra seems to have forgotten something
docs.text:
Sandra's memory is based on lessons completed, notes taken, and insights generated. If she seems unaware of something, check:

  • That the lesson or content was fully completed (not just opened)
  • That the note was saved (not left as a draft)

You can also view what Sandra knows in Memories.

docs.title: Conversation history is missing
docs.text: Conversations are tied to your account session. If you signed in on a new device, you may need to scroll up to find older threads. If threads are genuinely missing, contact support.

docs.title: A course isn't loading
docs.text:
• Check your internet connection
  • Try refreshing the page
  • Clear your browser cache and reload
  • If using mobile, try force-closing the app and reopening

docs.title: My progress wasn't saved
docs.text:
Progress is saved automatically at the end of each lesson. If your progress seems lost:

  • Check that you completed the lesson fully (reached the end) rather than just opening it
  • Make sure you were signed in when you completed it — guest sessions do not save progress

docs.title: A lesson video isn't playing
docs.text:
• Check that your browser allows autoplay for blinklearn.com
  • Try a different browser or device
  • Disable VPN or firewall tools that may block the video CDN

docs.title: I can't find a course I enrolled in
docs.text: Go to your Library — all enrolled courses appear there. Use the filter to show Courses.

docs.title: Content seems outdated
docs.text: Course content is managed by the author. If you believe content is incorrect or outdated, use the feedback option inside the lesson to report it to the author.

docs.title: Incorrect email or password
docs.text:
Double-check that you're using the same email and password you registered with. Passwords are case-sensitive.

Use Forgot password? on the login page to reset if needed.

docs.title: Google sign-in not working
docs.text:
• Make sure you are selecting the same Google account you used to register
  • Try clearing your browser cache and cookies, then attempt Google sign-in again
  • Disable browser extensions temporarily and retry

docs.title: Account locked or suspended
docs.text: If you see a message that your account is locked, contact support. Do not attempt to create a new account with the same email.

docs.title: Signed up but can't sign in
docs.text: Check your email for a verification link if you registered with email and password. The link must be clicked before your account is active.

docs.title: Shared Envisioning credentials
docs.text: BlinkLearn shares identity with other Envisioning products. If you've changed your password in BlinkLife or another product, use the updated password here too.

docs.text: Everything related to your BlinkLife account.

docs.title: In this section

  • Password Reset — recover access when you've forgotten your password
  • Profile & Settings — display name, email, and account preferences
  • Deleting Your Account — permanently close your account

docs.title: Deleting Your Account
docs.text: Deleting your BlinkLife account is permanent. All your data — notes, tasks, pages, chats, memories, diary entries — will be erased and cannot be recovered.

docs.title: Before you delete
docs.text: Consider exporting or copying anything you want to keep: - Export memories from Memories → Export - Copy key notes or pages manually

docs.title: How to delete your account
docs.text:
1. Click your name at the bottom of the sidebar to open the profile menu.
  2. Select Settings.
  3. Navigate to the Account tab.
  4. Scroll to the bottom and click Delete account.
  5. Confirm your decision in the dialog that appears.

Account deletion takes effect immediately.

docs.title: After deletion
docs.text:
• You will be signed out and cannot sign back in with this email
  • Any active subscription is cancelled — you will not be billed further
  • Your data is removed from BlinkLife's servers in accordance with their privacy policy

If you signed up via Google, deleting the BlinkLife account does not affect your Google account.

docs.title: Password Reset
docs.text: If you have forgotten your password, request a reset link from the login screen.

docs.title: How to reset your password
docs.text:
1. Go to blinklife.com and enter your email address, then click Continue.
  2. On the password screen, click Forgot?.
  3. BlinkLife sends a reset link to your email address.
  4. Click the link in the email and set a new password.

The reset link expires after a set period. If it has expired, request a new one by repeating the steps above.

docs.title: If you signed up with Google
docs.text: Accounts created via Google SSO do not have a BlinkLife password. Sign in using Sign in with Google — you do not need a reset link.

docs.title: Still locked out?
docs.text: If you no longer have access to the email address you signed up with, contact BlinkLife support from the login screen (Need help? link).

docs.title: Profile & Settings
docs.text: Access account settings by clicking your name at the bottom of the sidebar, then selecting Settings.

docs.title: Profile
docs.text: Your profile shows your display name and email address. The display name is used by Sandra throughout the platform.

docs.title: Public profile
docs.text: BlinkLife has a public profile feature. From the profile menu, click Public Profile to view or manage what is visible to others. Pages you set to Public visibility appear on your public profile.

docs.title: Settings sections
docs.text:
Settings are organised into tabs (accessible via the avatar menu → Settings):

Tab What it controls Account Email address, password, sign-in method Notifications Routine delivery preferences, email notifications Integrations Connected apps (Google Calendar, Gmail, Telegram, Google Docs) Billing Subscription and credit information

docs.title: Sign out
docs.text: Click your name at the bottom of the sidebar, then click Sign Out to log out of BlinkLife on this device.

docs.title: Signing In
docs.text: Go to blinklife.com and click Sign in.

docs.title: Signing in with email
docs.text:
BlinkLife uses a two-step login:

  1. Enter your Email address and click Continue.
  2. Enter your Password and click Continue again.

docs.title: Signing in with Google
docs.text: On the login screen, click Sign in with Google. If you created your account with Google, this is the only sign-in method you need — no password required.

docs.title: Staying signed in
docs.text: BlinkLife keeps you signed in on trusted devices. If you are signed out unexpectedly, simply sign in again.

docs.title: Having trouble?
docs.text:
• Forgot your password → Password Reset
  • "Incorrect email or password" → confirm the email is the one you signed up with, then reset your password
  • Google SSO not working → see Login Issues

docs.title: Billing & Credits
docs.text: Manage your BlinkLife subscription and credit balance from within the app.

docs.title: Accessing billing
docs.text:
1. Click your name at the bottom of the sidebar.
  2. Select Settings.
  3. Navigate to the Billing tab.

docs.title: Subscription plans
docs.text: BlinkLife offers paid plans with different levels of access to Sandra's capabilities and storage. Details of current plans and pricing are shown in the Billing tab inside the app.

docs.title: AI Credits
docs.text: Some actions — particularly intensive or long Chat sessions — consume AI credits. Your current credit balance is displayed in Settings → Billing. Credits replenish on your billing cycle.

docs.title: Cancelling your subscription
docs.text: To cancel, go to Settings → Billing and select the cancellation option. Your subscription remains active until the end of the paid period, after which your account moves to the free tier.

docs.title: Refunds and billing issues
docs.text: For billing disputes or refund requests, contact BlinkLife support via the Help link inside the app.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
BlinkLife's core features, each explained in its own guide.

Feature Description Chat Free-form conversation with Sandra, your AI companion Notes Rich text notes with AI integration, linked to tasks and projects Tasks & Projects Manage tasks and organise them into projects Pages AI-generated reports, briefings, and dashboards Brains Curated knowledge collections that Sandra draws from Listener Audio capture that turns meetings and lectures into notes Calendar View and navigate your calendar events Memories Sandra's knowledge graph — everything she has learned about you Pulse & Routines AI activity monitor and scheduled routines Skills Specialized AI tools that extend what Sandra can do AI Companion (My AI) Customise Sandra's personality, name, and communication style AI Diary Daily entries auto-generated by Sandra from your interactions

docs.title: AI Companion (My AI)
docs.text: My AI is where you configure Sandra — her personality, communication style, name, and how she understands you. Go to My AI in the sidebar.

docs.title: Tabs in My AI
docs.text: Tab What it controls Personality Archetype, communication rules, anti-patterns Profile Companion name My Human Information about you that Sandra should know Structured / Soul.md Advanced view of Sandra's core instructions

docs.title: Personality archetypes
docs.text:
Choose an archetype to set Sandra's overall communication tone. The current default is Friend.

Friend means Sandra: - Talks like someone who genuinely knows and likes you — casual, warm, real - Has opinions and shares them honestly — she does not just validate - Matches your energy — excited when you are, listens first when you are venting - Uses humor naturally, not forced - References past conversations to show she remembers

Other archetypes shift the default tone (e.g. more structured, more formal, more Socratic). Select the one that fits how you want to work with Sandra.

docs.title: Editing communication rules
docs.text: Within the Personality tab, you can add, remove, or rewrite the specific rules that govern how Sandra communicates. Changes take effect immediately on the next message.

docs.title: Renaming Sandra
docs.text: Go to My AI → Profile and edit the companion name field. The name change applies across the entire interface immediately (up to a set character limit).

docs.title: My Human tab
docs.text: Tell Sandra about yourself — your role, your goals, your working style. The more she knows, the more relevant her responses become. This context supplements what she learns from your conversations and memories.

docs.title: Soul.md
docs.text: An advanced view of Sandra's full instruction set in a structured format. This is for users who want to inspect or understand the complete personality configuration.

docs.title: AI Diary
docs.text: AI Diary is a running journal of your days, written automatically by Sandra. Each entry is generated from your activity — conversations, notes, tasks completed, and events — without you having to write anything yourself.

docs.title: How the diary works
docs.text:
Sandra writes a diary entry for each day based on: - Your conversations with her that day - Notes and tasks you created - Calendar events from your connected calendar - Any explicit reflections you shared in Chat

The Nightly Reflection routine (10:00 PM by default) triggers this — Sandra writes the entry as part of your end-of-day routine.

docs.title: Viewing entries
docs.text:
Go to Diary in the sidebar. The diary shows a calendar-style list of dates. Tap any date to read that day's entry.

  • Dates with entries show the entry preview
  • Dates with no activity show No entry

Use Jump to date to navigate quickly to a specific month or date.

docs.title: 104 entries
docs.text: The diary accumulates over time. Your account may already have entries from previous activity even if recent dates show "No entry" — use Load older at the bottom of the list to see earlier months.

docs.title: Editing the Nightly routine
docs.text: The Daily Diary is generated by the Daily Diary default routine (11:00 PM). To change the time or adjust what Sandra includes, go to Pulse → Routines and click Edit on the Daily Diary routine.

docs.title: Requesting a diary entry manually
docs.text: You can also ask Sandra in Chat to write a diary entry on demand: - "Write a diary entry for today" - "Summarise what I did this week as a diary"

docs.title: Brains
docs.text: Brains are curated knowledge collections that you build and Sandra draws from. When you add sources to a Brain, Sandra can reference that content when answering questions — making her responses more grounded in your specific context.

docs.title: What is a Brain?
docs.text: A Brain is a named collection of sources — documents, URLs, files, or text — that you want Sandra to know about. You might create a Brain for a project, a topic you are researching, or a body of reference material.

docs.title: Creating a Brain
docs.text:
1. Go to Brains in the sidebar and click + New Brain.
  2. Give the Brain a name (e.g. "Q3 Strategy", "Reading List", "Client Background").
  3. Add sources to the Brain using Add first source.

docs.title: Adding sources
docs.text: You can add various source types to a Brain — documents you upload, URLs, notes, or manually entered text. Sandra indexes the content and can reference it in conversation.

docs.title: Using a Brain in Chat
docs.text:
When you chat with Sandra, she automatically draws on the Brains you have built. You can also reference a Brain explicitly:

  • "Based on the Ideas Brain, what themes come up most?"
  • "Summarise the content in my Q3 Strategy Brain"

docs.title: Brain tips
docs.text:
• Keep each Brain focused on a single topic or project for better results
  • Add sources as you collect them — Sandra's answers improve as the Brain grows
  • You can have multiple Brains active simultaneously

docs.title: Calendar
docs.text: The Calendar shows your upcoming events and helps Sandra brief you on your day. It requires connecting a calendar integration to populate with events.

docs.title: Views
docs.text:
Go to Calendar in the sidebar to switch between views:

View What it shows Today Today's events with time slots Week Full week at a glance Month Monthly overview

The calendar shows total meetings booked and total time for the current view.

docs.title: Connecting a calendar
docs.text:
Calendar events come from your connected Google Calendar. If the calendar shows Sync failed or no events, you need to connect the integration first.

Go to Google Calendar integration for setup steps.

docs.title: Sandra and your calendar
docs.text:
Once your calendar is connected, Sandra references your events:

  • Home briefings — Sandra surfaces upcoming meetings proactively ("You've got Sarah at 2:00 PM today")
  • Listener routines — Sandra can create Listener session notes linked to your calendar events
  • Calendar routines — enables additional automated routines in Pulse

If you see "Sync failed", see Calendar Sync Issues.

docs.title: Chat
docs.text: Chat is your primary way to interact with Sandra. Every conversation is stored and Sandra carries context across sessions — she remembers what you discussed previously.

docs.title: Starting a conversation
docs.text: Go to Chats in the sidebar and click New chat. Type anything — Sandra responds as your companion, drawing on what she knows about you from your notes, tasks, memories, and past conversations.

docs.title: What Sandra can do in Chat
docs.text:
• Answer questions and give opinions based on your context
  • Help you think through a decision or problem
  • Create tasks, notes, and pages from within the conversation
  • Invoke skills (e.g. run a Weekly Review or Meeting Summary)
  • Brief you on your day, upcoming meetings, or open tasks
  • Reflect on your patterns and habits over time

docs.title: Conversation history
docs.text: All your chats are stored in the sidebar under Chats. Click any conversation to resume it. Sandra treats each chat as continuous — she remembers what was said even if you start a new session.

docs.title: Invoking skills from Chat
docs.text:
During a conversation you can trigger any skill directly:

  1. Type what you want to do (e.g. "run a weekly review" or "summarize my notes from this week")
  2. Sandra will invoke the relevant skill and guide you through it

You can also open the Skills panel from within Chat to browse and select a skill manually.

docs.title: Sandra's limits
docs.text: Sandra will not give medical, legal, or financial advice. If a question falls outside her scope, she will acknowledge it and suggest a qualified professional.

docs.title: Listener
docs.text: Listener captures audio during meetings, lectures, and conversations — and turns it into a structured note. Sandra listens alongside you and produces a note worth keeping.

docs.title: Starting a session
docs.text:
Go to Listener in the sidebar (under CAPTURE). Choose your capture mode:

Mode What it captures Microphone The room around you — in-person meetings, conversations, lectures Mic + Computer Microphone audio plus anything playing on your device (Zoom, Google Meet, YouTube, etc.)

Click Start Listening to begin. Sandra starts transcribing in real time.

docs.title: During a session
docs.text:
While Listener is active, Sandra transcribes what she hears. You can:

  • Leave it running in the background while you focus on the meeting
  • Switch to another tab — Listener continues capturing

docs.title: After a session
docs.text:
When you stop the session, Sandra processes the transcript and creates a structured note. The note is saved automatically and appears in the Listener tab in Notes. It will include:

  • A summary of the key points discussed
  • Action items extracted from the conversation
  • Any decisions or commitments mentioned

docs.title: Finding listener notes
docs.text: Go to Notes → Listener tab to see all notes generated from Listener sessions. Listener notes are tagged and kept separate from your manually created notes.

docs.title: Tips for best results
docs.text:
• Use Mic + Computer for Zoom or Google Meet calls — it captures both your audio and the other speakers
  • Use Microphone for in-person meetings in a quiet room
  • Speak clearly and avoid heavy background noise for better transcription accuracy

docs.title: Memories
docs.text: Memories is Sandra's knowledge graph — everything she has learned about you through your conversations, notes, and interactions.

docs.title: What Sandra remembers
docs.text:
Sandra builds memories automatically. They are organised as entity types:

Type Examples Document Notes, pages, files she has read Organization Companies, teams, or services you've mentioned Person People you've discussed Goal Objectives you've shared with Sandra Topic Recurring themes (productivity, health, strategy)

docs.title: Viewing memories
docs.text:
Go to Memory in the sidebar. You can switch between three views:

View What it shows Latest Most recently added memories, in chronological order Graph A visual network showing how memories connect Tree A hierarchical view grouped by type

The count shown (e.g. "14 entities") reflects how many distinct memories Sandra has built.

docs.title: Exporting and importing
docs.text: Use the Export and Import buttons at the top of the Memories page to back up or migrate your memory graph.

docs.title: Updating memories
docs.text:
Memories are built automatically — you cannot edit them directly. To update or remove a specific memory, ask Sandra in Chat:

  • "Forget that I'm working on the PagerDuty project"
  • "Update my role — I'm now focusing on infrastructure"
  • "Remove the memory about the Ideas Brain"

Sandra will acknowledge the change and update her knowledge graph.

docs.title: How memories improve Sandra
docs.text: The more Sandra remembers, the more relevant her responses become. She references memories to: - Avoid asking you the same questions twice - Connect current conversations to past ones - Personalise briefings and suggestions

docs.title: Notes
docs.text: Notes is BlinkLife's workspace for capturing ideas, reflections, meeting notes, and anything worth keeping. Notes are integrated with your tasks, projects, and Sandra.

docs.title: Creating a note
docs.text:
Go to Notes in the sidebar and click New Note. A blank editor opens.

The title is set automatically based on your content — you do not need to type one separately.

docs.title: The editor
docs.text:
The notes editor supports rich formatting:

Block type How to add Headings (H1–H3) Type #, ##, or ### then space Bullet list Type - then space Numbered list Type 1. then space Checklist / task Type [] then space Table Use the block menu Image Paste, drag, or use the block menu Video embed Paste a video URL Divider Type --- Code block Type ```

You can also paste Markdown directly — the editor formats it automatically.

docs.title: Linking to projects and tasks
docs.text: At the top of every note, you can assign it to a Project and a Task. This keeps your notes connected to the work they belong to.

docs.title: Note categories
docs.text:
Notes are organised into tabs:

Tab What it shows All Every note Documents Notes created manually Listener Notes generated from Listener sessions Archived Notes you've archived Tags Notes filtered by tag Graph A visual graph of how your notes connect

docs.title: Sandra in Notes
docs.text: The AI panel on the right side of the editor gives you access to Sandra while writing. You can ask her to expand a section, summarize a note, or extract action items — without leaving the editor.

docs.title: Pages
docs.text: Pages are AI-generated documents — reports, briefings, dashboards, and summaries that Sandra creates for you. They live in one place and can be kept private or shared.

docs.title: How pages are created
docs.text:
Ask Sandra in Chat to produce a document:

  • "Create a weekly summary of my notes"
  • "Build a project status page for the PagerDuty automation"
  • "Write a briefing I can share with my team"

Sandra generates the page and it appears in your Pages list.

docs.title: Visibility settings
docs.text:
Visibility Access Private Only you Private Link Anyone with the URL Public Discoverable by others

Change visibility from within any page at any time.

docs.title: Managing pages
docs.text:
Go to Pages in the sidebar to see all your generated documents. Tabs let you filter by visibility:

  • All — every page
  • Private — private-only pages
  • Private Link — link-shared pages
  • Public — publicly visible pages
  • Newest — sorted by creation date

From the pages list you can open, share, or delete any page.

docs.title: Pulse & Routines
docs.text: Pulse is Sandra's activity monitor — a summary of what she is watching and doing for you. Routines are scheduled actions Sandra runs automatically on your behalf.

docs.title: Pulse
docs.text:
Go to Pulse in the sidebar to see Sandra's status at a glance.

Stat What it means Last chat How long since your most recent conversation with Sandra Things remembered Total memories Sandra has built about you Day streak Consecutive days you have been active Status "All Clear" or a list of items needing your attention

Click Run Check to trigger a fresh Pulse evaluation — Sandra reviews what she knows and updates the status.

docs.title: Routines
docs.text: Go to Pulse → Routines to see all routines Sandra runs for you.

docs.title: Default routines
docs.text:
BlinkLife includes four default routines that activate automatically:

Routine When it runs What it does Morning Briefing Daily at 7:00 AM Sandra reviews your calendar, tasks, and context — sends you a briefing for the day Daily Diary Daily at 11:00 PM Sandra writes a diary entry based on your day's activity Nightly Reflection Daily at 10:00 PM Sandra prompts a short reflection on your day Weekly Summary Sundays at 6:00 PM Sandra compiles a summary of the week

All times are shown in your local timezone.

docs.title: App-activated routines
docs.text: Connecting integrations (Calendar, Gmail) unlocks additional routines. These appear under Activated by Your Apps once the relevant integration is set up.

docs.title: Custom routines
docs.text:
Ask Sandra in Chat to create a routine: - "Create a routine that runs every Monday morning and reviews my open projects" - "Add a weekly check-in on my reading goal every Friday at 5pm"

Custom routines appear under Your Routines in the Routines tab.

docs.title: Editing routines
docs.text: Tap Edit next to any routine to change its schedule or instructions.

docs.title: Skills
docs.text: Skills are specialized AI tools that extend what Sandra can do. Each skill is a focused capability with a defined purpose — invoked in Chat or triggered automatically.

docs.title: Browsing the library
docs.text:
Go to Skills in the sidebar to see the full library — 33 skills at launch, organized by category.

Category Count Examples Meetings 3 Meeting Summary, Action Items, Decision Log Writing 5 Note Cleaner, Page Designer, Email Draft Email 2 Email Reply, Email Summary Review 4 Design Review, Page Critic, Feedback Synthesizer Planning 7 Goal Review, Daily Briefing, Weekly Review, Project Plan Scheduling 1 Calendar Planner Decisions 1 Decision Framework Leadership 1 Team Update Memory 2 Memory Sweep, Knowledge Capture Learning 3 Extract Knowledge, Web Reader, Concept Explainer Health 1 Health Check-in Social Media 2 Post Draft, Thread Writer

docs.title: Using a skill
docs.text:
1. Open Chat and describe what you want to do (e.g. "summarize today's meeting notes")
  2. Sandra identifies the relevant skill and invokes it, or you can open the Skills panel inside Chat and select one manually

docs.title: Creating a custom skill
docs.text: Click Create Skill at the top of the Skills page to build your own. Define the skill's purpose, trigger, and expected output. Custom skills appear in your library alongside the built-in ones.

docs.title: Customising skill prompts
docs.text: Click any skill to open its settings and edit the underlying prompt. This lets you tailor how a skill behaves to your specific needs and preferences.

docs.title: Tasks & Projects
docs.text: BlinkLife lets you capture tasks quickly and organise them into projects. Sandra is aware of your tasks and references them in briefings and conversations.

docs.title: Tasks
docs.text: Go to Tasks in the sidebar to see all your open tasks.

docs.title: Creating a task
docs.text:
Click Add task or New Task to capture something quickly. Tasks can be created:

  • Directly from the Tasks page
  • By asking Sandra in Chat ("add a task: review the proposal by Friday")
  • From within a note using a checklist block

docs.title: Managing tasks
docs.text:
Tab What it shows Active All open, incomplete tasks Completed Tasks you've marked done

Use the Display options to filter and sort your task list.

docs.title: Projects
docs.text: Go to Projects in the sidebar to organise tasks into named projects.

docs.title: Creating a project
docs.text: Click New Project and give it a name. Projects show a count of open and completed tasks.

docs.title: Linking tasks to a project
docs.text: When creating or editing a task, select the project it belongs to. You can also link a note to a project from within the note editor.

docs.title: Project tabs
docs.text: Tab What it shows All Every active project Archived Projects you've completed or archived

docs.title: Sandra and your tasks
docs.text: Sandra references your tasks on the Home page briefing and in Chat. If you ask her "what do I have on my plate?", she will summarise your active tasks and flag anything time-sensitive.

docs.title: Getting Started with BlinkLife
docs.text: BlinkLife is an AI companion platform built around Sandra — an AI that learns about you, manages your workspace, and helps you think through your day. These guides walk you through setting up and getting your bearings.

docs.title: In this section
docs.text:
• Creating Your Account — sign up with email or Google
  • Personalising Your Companion — set Sandra's personality, name, and communication style
  • Your Home Page — understand your daily briefing and what Sandra watches for you

docs.title: Creating Your Account
docs.text: Go to blinklife.com and click Sign in to create a new account or log in.

docs.title: Signing up with email
docs.text:
1. On the welcome screen, enter your Email address and click Continue.
  2. If this is a new account, you will be prompted to set a Password.
  3. Complete any onboarding steps — BlinkLife will introduce you to Sandra and ask a few setup questions.

docs.title: Signing up with Google
docs.text: Below the email field, click Sign in with Google to create your account using your Google credentials. No separate password is required.

docs.title: Onboarding
docs.text:
After signup, BlinkLife walks you through:

  1. Meeting Sandra — your AI companion
  2. Setting Sandra's personality (archetype, communication style)
  3. Naming Sandra if you prefer a different name

All of these settings can be changed later from My AI.

docs.title: Already have an account?
docs.text: Go to Signing In if you already have an account and need help logging in.

docs.title: Your Home Page
docs.text: When you log in, BlinkLife opens on the Home page (/today) — your daily command center.

docs.title: What you see on Home
docs.text: Section What it shows Daily greeting Sandra's good morning message, personalised to your day FROM SANDRA Proactive briefings — upcoming meetings, items Sandra flagged, context you should know Calendar preview Today's events pulled from your connected calendar Tasks Active tasks Sandra is aware of

docs.title: Sandra's briefings
docs.text:
Sandra monitors what she knows about your day and surfaces relevant context without you asking. Examples:

  • "You've got a meeting with Sarah at 2:00 PM — not sure what it's about yet, worth a heads-up."
  • "You've got the PagerDuty automation project on your plate."

These briefings come from your connected calendar, your tasks, your notes, and your conversation history with Sandra.

docs.title: Sidebar navigation
docs.text:
The sidebar on the left is your primary navigation. Sections:

Section Items — Home, Chats WORKSPACE Tasks, Projects, Notes, Pages CAPTURE Listener AI My AI, Memory, Skills, Brains, Diary, Pulse

docs.title: What to do in your first week
docs.text:
1. Chat with Sandra — start a conversation and let her get to know you
  2. Create a note — capture something you're working on
  3. Connect your calendar — go to Google Calendar integration so Sandra can brief you on meetings
  4. Check Pulse — see what Sandra is monitoring and enable your default routines

docs.title: Personalising Your Companion
docs.text: Sandra is your AI companion. By default she uses the Friend archetype — casual, warm, and direct. You can change her personality, name, and how she communicates from My AI in the sidebar.

docs.title: Personality archetypes
docs.text:
Go to My AI → Personality to choose an archetype. Each archetype defines how Sandra speaks, what she prioritises, and how she frames her responses. The default is Friend.

Friend archetype characteristics: - Talks like someone who genuinely knows and likes you — casual, warm, real - Has opinions and shares them honestly - Matches your energy - Uses humor naturally - References past conversations to show she remembers

Other archetypes are available and can be selected to change Sandra's tone entirely.

docs.title: Customising communication style
docs.text: Within the personality settings you can also edit the specific rules Sandra follows — add, remove, or rewrite the behaviors listed under your current archetype. Changes take effect on the next message.

docs.title: Renaming your companion
docs.text: Go to My AI → Profile to rename Sandra to anything you prefer. The name change applies everywhere in the interface immediately.

docs.title: My Human and Soul.md tabs
docs.text:
• My Human — lets you describe yourself so Sandra has context about who you are
  • Soul.md — an advanced view of Sandra's core instructions in structured format

docs.title: Integrations
docs.text: Connect BlinkLife with tools you already use to bring your schedule, messages, and documents into one place.

docs.title: Available integrations
docs.text:
• Google Calendar — sync your events into BlinkLife's Calendar and your daily briefing
  • Gmail — surface important emails in Sandra's daily summary
  • Telegram — message Sandra directly from Telegram without opening the app
  • Google Docs — attach and reference Google documents inside your notes and pages

docs.title: Coming soon
docs.text: Bridge and WhatsApp integrations are in development and not yet available to all users. They will appear in Settings → Integrations when enabled for your account.

docs.title: Managing integrations
docs.text: All integrations are managed from Settings → Integrations (click your name at the bottom of the sidebar, then select Settings).

docs.title: Gmail
docs.text: Connect Gmail to let Sandra surface important emails in your daily briefing and respond to email-related questions in Chat.

docs.title: Connecting Gmail
docs.text:
1. Go to Settings → Integrations.
  2. Click Connect next to Gmail.
  3. Sign in with your Google account and approve the requested permissions.

docs.title: What Sandra can do with Gmail
docs.text:
• Include a summary of unread or priority emails in your Morning Briefing
  • Answer questions like "Do I have any emails from [name] this week?" in Chat
  • Flag emails you might have missed based on your stated priorities

BlinkLife does not send emails on your behalf.

docs.title: Privacy
docs.text: BlinkLife reads email metadata and content only to generate summaries within Sandra's context. Email content is not stored or used to train models.

docs.title: Disconnecting
docs.text: Go to Settings → Integrations and click Disconnect next to Gmail.

docs.title: Google Calendar
docs.text: Connect Google Calendar to bring your schedule into BlinkLife. Your events appear in the Calendar tab and are included in Sandra's Daily Briefing routine each morning.

docs.title: Connecting Google Calendar
docs.text:
1. Go to Settings → Integrations.
  2. Click Connect next to Google Calendar.
  3. Sign in with the Google account that holds your calendar.
  4. Approve the permissions BlinkLife requests.

Once connected, events from your primary Google Calendar sync into BlinkLife automatically.

docs.title: What syncs
docs.text:
• All events from your primary Google Calendar
  • Event title, time, date, and description
  • Recurring events

BlinkLife reads your calendar — it does not write events back to Google Calendar from BlinkLife.

docs.title: Calendar in the daily briefing
docs.text: Sandra's Morning Briefing routine includes today's calendar events by default. If you want to adjust what Sandra says about them, edit the Morning Briefing routine in Pulse → Routines.

docs.title: Disconnecting
docs.text: Go to Settings → Integrations and click Disconnect next to Google Calendar. Your past calendar events remain in BlinkLife's Calendar view but will not update further.

docs.title: Google Docs
docs.text: Connect Google Docs to reference and attach your Google documents directly inside BlinkLife notes and pages.

docs.title: Connecting Google Docs
docs.text:
1. Go to Settings → Integrations.
  2. Click Connect next to Google Docs.
  3. Sign in with your Google account and approve the permissions.

docs.title: Using Google Docs in BlinkLife
docs.text:
Once connected, you can link a Google Doc inside a BlinkLife Note or Page using the / command menu: - Type /google or /docs and search for a document by name - The linked doc appears as an embedded card with the document title and a link to open it

Sandra can also reference linked documents when you ask questions in Chat — for example, "Summarise the document I attached to the Q3 planning note."

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text: BlinkLife reads document content to generate summaries on request. It does not edit or share Google Docs on your behalf.

docs.title: Disconnecting
docs.text: Go to Settings → Integrations and click Disconnect next to Google Docs.

docs.title: Telegram
docs.text: Connect Telegram to send messages to Sandra without opening BlinkLife. Your conversation syncs back to the Chat tab.

docs.title: Connecting Telegram
docs.text:
1. Go to Settings → Integrations.
  2. Click Connect next to Telegram.
  3. Follow the instructions to link your Telegram account (typically by starting a conversation with the BlinkLife bot from the Telegram app).

docs.title: Using Sandra via Telegram
docs.text:
Once connected, message the BlinkLife bot in Telegram as you would in the Chat tab: - Ask questions, capture thoughts, add tasks - Sandra replies in Telegram and the conversation appears in your BlinkLife Chat history

Telegram is useful for capturing ideas on the go without switching apps.

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• You cannot access Notes, Pages, or Calendar directly from Telegram — those require the BlinkLife app
  • Voice messages sent in Telegram do not trigger Listener; use the in-app mic for that

docs.title: Disconnecting
docs.text: Go to Settings → Integrations and click Disconnect next to Telegram.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Common issues and how to fix them.

docs.title: In this section
docs.text:
• Chat & Sandra Issues — Sandra not responding, slow replies, unexpected answers
  • Listener Issues — microphone not activating, transcription errors
  • Calendar Sync Issues — events not appearing, sync delays
  • Login Issues — can't sign in, Google SSO errors, account locked

docs.title: General tips
docs.text:
Before diving into a specific issue, try these first:

  1. Refresh the page — most transient errors clear on reload.
  2. Sign out and back in — clears stale session state.
  3. Check your internet connection — Sandra requires an active connection for all responses.
  4. Try a different browser — rules out browser-specific issues.

docs.title: Still stuck?
docs.text: Use the Help link inside the BlinkLife app to contact support.

docs.title: Events not appearing in BlinkLife
docs.text:
Symptom: You added an event in Google Calendar but it is not showing in BlinkLife's Calendar tab.

Try: 1. Wait a few minutes — sync is not instant. 2. Refresh the BlinkLife page. 3. Go to Settings → Integrations and confirm Google Calendar shows as Connected. 4. Disconnect and reconnect Google Calendar to force a fresh sync.

docs.title: Events from the wrong calendar are showing
docs.text:
BlinkLife syncs your primary Google Calendar. If your events are in a secondary calendar or a shared calendar, they may not appear.

To check: in Google Calendar, verify the event is on the calendar marked "Primary" (usually your email address).

docs.title: Daily briefing does not include today's events
docs.text: Sandra's Morning Briefing routine reads your calendar at the time the routine runs. If you added an event after the briefing ran, it will not be in that day's briefing — but you can ask Sandra directly: "What's on my calendar today?"

docs.title: Past events disappeared
docs.text: BlinkLife's Calendar shows a rolling window of events. Very old events may not be visible by default. Use the calendar date picker to navigate to a specific date.

docs.title: Disconnecting and reconnecting
docs.text: If sync is persistently broken: 1. Settings → Integrations → Disconnect Google Calendar. 2. Wait 30 seconds. 3. Connect Google Calendar again and re-approve permissions.

docs.title: Sandra is not responding
docs.text:
Symptom: You send a message and nothing happens, or the typing indicator spins indefinitely.

Try: 1. Wait 30 seconds — complex requests take longer. 2. Refresh the page and resend your message. 3. Check that you have an active internet connection. 4. If the issue persists, sign out and back in.

docs.title: Sandra gives an unexpected or wrong answer
docs.text:
Sandra generates responses based on context from your notes, calendar, and conversation history. If an answer seems wrong:

  • Ask her to clarify: "Can you explain why you said that?"
  • Provide more context in your follow-up message.
  • If a factual error persists, she does not have access to real-time information — use the web for live facts.

docs.title: Sandra has "forgotten" something I told her
docs.text:
Chat history is stored and Sandra can be asked to recall it: - "What did I tell you about my Q3 goals?" - "Look back at our conversation from last week."

If something was said in a session that was cleared, it may not be recoverable. For anything important, save it as a Note.

docs.title: Messages are sending but Sandra is not reading my notes
docs.text: Ensure the Brain or Note you're referencing is linked to the correct Brain and that the Brain is active. Go to Brains and confirm the relevant Brain shows as connected.

docs.title: Credits exhausted
docs.text: If you see a "credits" warning, your AI credit balance may be low. Check Settings → Billing and wait for your next billing cycle or top up credits.

docs.title: Microphone not activating
docs.text:
Symptom: Clicking the mic icon does nothing, or the browser asks for microphone permission repeatedly.

Try: 1. Check your browser's microphone permissions: - Chrome: address bar → padlock icon → Microphone → Allow - Safari: Preferences → Websites → Microphone → Allow for blinklife.com 2. Refresh the page after granting permission. 3. Ensure no other app (Zoom, Meet) is using the microphone exclusively.

docs.title: Transcription is inaccurate
docs.text:
Listener uses your device microphone and works best in quiet environments with clear speech. To improve accuracy: - Speak at a steady pace and volume. - Reduce background noise. - Use a dedicated microphone or headset instead of a built-in laptop mic.

If a transcription is slightly wrong, you can edit the note after it is created.

docs.title: "Listen to my computer" not working
docs.text: The Listen to my computer mode requires access to your system audio output, which requires additional browser permissions (or a system-level extension in some browsers). If it fails: - Try in Chrome — it has the broadest audio capture support. - Check that system audio is playing before activating Listener. - Some operating systems block browser access to system audio entirely; in those cases, use the microphone-only mode.

docs.title: Listener stops mid-session
docs.text: Listener sessions can time out after extended silence. If it stops unexpectedly: - Click the mic icon again to restart. - Check that the browser tab is not backgrounded aggressively (some browsers throttle background tabs).

docs.title: "Incorrect email or password"
docs.text:
• Confirm you are using the email address you signed up with.
  • Passwords are case-sensitive — check Caps Lock.
  • If you signed up with Google SSO, there is no BlinkLife password — use Sign in with Google instead.
  • Reset your password if you are unsure.

docs.title: Google Sign-In is not working
docs.text:
Symptom: Clicking Sign in with Google opens the Google prompt but returns an error.

Try: 1. Ensure you are selecting the correct Google account (the one used to sign up). 2. Clear your browser cookies and cache, then try again. 3. Try a different browser or an incognito window. 4. If Google shows "Access blocked", the OAuth session may have expired — try signing out of Google and back in before retrying.

docs.title: Account says it doesn't exist
docs.text: If you receive "No account found for this email", you may: - Have signed up with a different email — check for other email addresses you own. - Have signed up with Google SSO but are now trying email login — try Sign in with Google. - Not yet have an account — go to blinklife.com and select Sign up.

docs.title: Locked out / can't access account email
docs.text: If you no longer have access to the email address associated with your account, contact BlinkLife support via the Need help? link on the login screen.

docs.title: Session expires immediately after login
docs.text: This can happen if your browser blocks third-party cookies. Allow cookies for blinklife.com in your browser settings, or try a browser with standard cookie settings.

docs.title: Finerminds
docs.text: Finerminds is a professional community platform for Mindvalley — a space where members connect through shared networks, conversations, events, and curated resources.

docs.title: What you can do
docs.text:
• Networks

    Join community hubs organised around teams, interests, or goals. Each network has a feed, chat, members, groups, resources, and events.

    → Networks

  • People

    Browse and connect with every member. Filter by city, industry, language, or interests to find the right people.

    → People

  • Chats

    Message anyone directly or join community conversations inside your networks.

    → Chats

  • Events

    Create and attend events within your networks. Track what you're going to, what you're hosting, and invitations you've received.

    → Events

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text:
New to Finerminds? Start here:

  1. Create your account
  2. Set up your profile
  3. Join your first network

docs.title: Account & Login
docs.text:
Manage your Finerminds account, profile, and privacy settings.
