docs.title: Editing Your Profile
docs.text:
Your profile tells the community who you are. Other members see it when browsing People, inside networks, and in chats.

Go to Settings → Edit profile to make changes.

docs.title: Profile photos
docs.text: Upload up to nine photos. The first photo in the order is your avatar — the image shown on your member card and in chats. Drag and drop photos to reorder them.

docs.title: Basic details
docs.text: Field Notes First name / Last name Your display name across Finerminds Home city Used for the "Near me" filter on the People page Frequent cities Up to three cities you travel to regularly Spoken languages Up to ten languages Interests Up to 25 tags — used to surface relevant members and content About me Free-text bio, up to 2,000 characters. Click Help me write for AI assistance

docs.title: Profession
docs.text: Field Notes Job title Your current role Company Your employer Industry Select from the industry list Field of work Sub-category within your industry

docs.title: Social links
docs.text: Add links to your website, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, or YouTube. These appear on your public profile page.

docs.title: Saving changes
docs.text: Click Save at the bottom of the page. Changes take effect immediately.

docs.title: Privacy & Data
docs.text: Go to Settings → Privacy & data to review your privacy options and access legal documents.

docs.title: What Finerminds stores
docs.text:
Finerminds stores the information you provide in your profile — name, photo, location, interests, profession, and social links — along with your activity such as messages, event RSVPs, and group memberships.

Your email address is used only for sign-in and account-related notifications. It is not shown on your public profile.

docs.title: What other members can see
docs.text: Information Visible to Name, avatar, job title All members Home city, languages, interests All members About me, social links All members Email address Nobody (private) Direct messages Only the participants

docs.title: Legal
docs.text:
From Settings → Privacy & data, you can read:

  • Terms of use — the rules governing your use of Finerminds
  • Privacy policy — how your data is collected, stored, and used

docs.title: Deleting your account
docs.text: To request account deletion, contact Mindvalley support. All your profile data, messages, and activity will be permanently removed.

docs.title: Signing In
docs.text: Go to finerminds.com and click Log in.

docs.title: Sign-in methods
docs.text:
• Google — click Continue with Google and choose your account
  • Email and password — enter the email address linked to your account

docs.title: Resetting your password
docs.text:
1. On the sign-in screen, click Forgot password?
  2. Enter your email address and click Send reset link
  3. Open the email and click the link — it expires after 24 hours
  4. Choose a new password and confirm it

Alternatively, go to Settings → My account and click Reset password while logged in.

docs.title: Changing your username
docs.text: Go to Settings → My account. Under Username, click Change and enter the @handle you want. Usernames must be unique across Finerminds.

docs.title: Changing your display name
docs.text: Go to Settings → Edit profile and update the First name and Last name fields.

docs.title: Signing out
docs.text: Go to Settings and click Log out at the bottom of the menu.

docs.title: All Features
docs.text: Feature What it does Networks Community hubs with feeds, groups, chat, members, resources, and events People Member directory with search and filters Chats Direct messages and community conversations Events Create and attend community events

docs.title: Chats
docs.text: Chats is your messaging hub — for direct one-on-one conversations and group discussions within your networks.

docs.title: Conversation types
docs.text:
Chats are split into three tabs:

Tab What it contains All Every conversation, most recent first Direct Messages Private one-on-one conversations with other members Communities Group chats tied to your networks

docs.title: Starting a direct message
docs.text:
1. Go to All people and open any member's profile
  2. Click Message — a direct message thread opens automatically
  3. Type your message and press Enter or click Send

Alternatively, go to Chats and use the compose button to search for a member by name.

docs.title: Community chats
docs.text: Each network has a shared group chat accessible from the network's Chat tab. All members of that network can read and post there.

docs.title: Reading and replying
docs.text:
Click any conversation in the left panel to open it on the right. Type in the message box at the bottom and press Enter to send.

Unread conversations are shown with a badge count on the All chats sidebar item and on the individual thread.

docs.title: Notifications
docs.text: You will receive an in-app notification when someone messages you directly or mentions you in a community chat. Notification settings can be adjusted in your device or browser preferences.

docs.title: Events
docs.text: Events lets you create, discover, and attend community gatherings — virtual or in-person — organised within your networks.

docs.title: Finding events
docs.text:
Go to All events in the sidebar. The page is organised into sections:

Section What it shows Going Events you have confirmed attendance for Invitations Events you have been invited to but not yet responded Hosting Events you created Past events Events that have already taken place Upcoming events All upcoming public events across your networks

docs.title: Creating an event
docs.text:
1. Click Create new event in the sidebar or Create an event on the events page
  2. Fill in the event details — title, date, time, location or virtual link, and description
  3. Choose which network the event belongs to
  4. Set visibility: Public (anyone in the network can see it) or Invite only
  5. Click Create to publish

Once created, the event appears in your Hosting tab and in the Events tab of the relevant network.

docs.title: Responding to an event
docs.text:
On any event card or event detail page:

  • Click Going to confirm attendance
  • Click Not going to decline
  • Click Interested if you are undecided

For invite-only events, you can only respond if you received an invitation.

docs.title: Managing your events
docs.text:
Open any event you are hosting to:

  • Edit details (title, date, description, location)
  • Invite specific members
  • View the attendee list
  • Cancel the event

docs.title: Events inside networks
docs.text: Events created within a network are visible to all members of that network under the network's Events tab. See Networks for more.

docs.title: Networks
docs.text: Networks are the heartbeat of Finerminds — shared community spaces where members, groups, conversations, resources, and events come together.

docs.title: Browsing networks
docs.text: Go to All networks in the sidebar to see every network you belong to and any public networks you can join. Each card shows the number of members, groups, and resources.

docs.title: Inside a network
docs.text:
Click any network to open it. Every network has six tabs:

Tab What it contains Feed Posts and updates from all members of this network Chat A shared group chat for quick conversations Members Everyone in the network, filterable by city, industry, language, and interests Resources Links and materials shared by members Events Events happening within this network

Your joined groups are listed in the left sidebar panel under My groups.

docs.title: Groups
docs.text:
Each network contains groups — smaller focused communities for specific interests or teams.

Groups can be:

  • Public — anyone in the network can see and join
  • Private — invite-only; content is hidden until you are a member

To join a public group, click Join on the group card. For private groups, request an invitation from a group admin.

docs.title: Members
docs.text:
The Members tab lists everyone in the network. Use the filters at the top to find members by:

  • Near me — members in a similar location
  • City — filter by home or frequent city
  • Industry — filter by professional industry
  • Languages — filter by spoken language
  • Interests — filter by shared interest tags

Click any member card to open their profile.

docs.title: Resources
docs.text: The Resources tab is a shared library for the network. Any member can add a resource by pasting a link to an article, tool, or website. Click New resource to contribute.

docs.title: Network events
docs.text: Events created within a network appear under the Events tab. See Events for how to create and manage them.

docs.title: People
docs.text: The People directory shows every member of Finerminds. Use it to find colleagues, collaborators, or community members with shared interests.

docs.title: Browsing members
docs.text: Go to All people in the sidebar. You will see a grid of member cards showing each person's name, job title, company, and location.

docs.title: Filtering
docs.text:
Use the filter bar at the top to narrow the list:

Filter What it does Near me Shows members in a similar geographic area City Filter by home city or frequent city Industry Filter by professional industry Languages Filter by spoken language Interests Filter by interest tags from member profiles

Filters can be combined. Clear any filter by clicking the × on its chip.

docs.title: Member profiles
docs.text:
Click any member card to open their profile.

A profile shows:

  • Name, avatar, and username
  • Job title and company
  • Home city and frequent travel locations
  • Spoken languages
  • About me
  • Interests
  • Social links (LinkedIn, website, etc.)

docs.title: Connecting
docs.text: To start a conversation with a member, open their profile and click Message. This opens a direct message thread in Chats.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
Get up and running on Finerminds in three steps.

  • Create your account

    Sign up with your email or an existing Mindvalley account.

    → Creating your account

  • Set up your profile

    Add a photo, your location, interests, and profession so others can find and connect with you.

    → Your profile and home page

  • Join a network

    Networks are where the community lives. Find one that fits your team or interests and join.

    → Networks

docs.title: Creating Your Account
docs.text:
Invite-only access

Finerminds is currently invite-only. There is no self-service sign-up. To request access, contact your Mindvalley team admin or ask an existing member to send you an invitation.

docs.title: Joining via invitation
docs.text:
When a network admin sends you an invite link:

  1. Open the link in your browser
  2. Sign in with your Mindvalley account (Google or email) or create one if you don't have one yet
  3. You'll be added to the network automatically after signing in

If you already use other Mindvalley products (BlinkLearn, BlinkLife, etc.), use the same email address — your account works across the platform.

docs.title: First-time setup
docs.text:
After signing in for the first time you will be prompted to complete your profile:

  1. Upload a profile photo
  2. Enter your name, home city, and job title
  3. Select your industry and interests
  4. Add any social links you want to share with the community

You can skip any of these steps and complete them later from Edit profile.

docs.title: Already have a Mindvalley account?
docs.text: Use the same email address you use for other Mindvalley products. Your account is shared across the Mindvalley platform — you do not need to create a new one.

docs.title: Home page
docs.text: When you log in, Finerminds takes you to the Networks page — the main hub for everything happening in your community. From here you can navigate to People, Chats, and Events using the sidebar.

docs.title: Your profile
docs.text: Your profile is your identity on Finerminds. Other members see it when they browse People or visit your network.

docs.title: What your profile shows
docs.text: Field Where it appears Name and avatar Everywhere — people directory, chat, networks Job title and company People directory and profile page Home city People directory filters Interests Recommended connections About me Profile page Social links Profile page

docs.title: Editing your profile
docs.text:
Go to Settings → Edit profile to update any of these fields. Changes are saved when you click Save.

See Editing your profile for full details.

docs.title: Navigation
docs.text:
The sidebar gives you access to all main sections:

Sidebar item What it opens All networks Networks listing All people Member directory All chats Your conversations All events Events calendar

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Common issues and how to resolve them.

Problem Guide Can't send or receive messages Chat issues Can't log in or password reset not arriving Login issues

If your issue is not listed here, contact Mindvalley support.

docs.title: Messages not sending
docs.text:
1. Check your internet connection — chats require an active connection
  2. Refresh the page and try again
  3. If the conversation shows an error icon next to the message, click it to retry sending

docs.title: Not receiving messages
docs.text:
• Check that your browser notifications for finerminds.com are allowed:
    • Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Site settings → Notifications
    • Safari: Preferences → Websites → Notifications → Allow for finerminds.com
  • Check that you haven't muted the conversation

docs.title: Conversation not loading
docs.text:
1. Hard-refresh the page (Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows/Linux, Cmd+Shift+R on Mac)
  2. Clear your browser cache and reload
  3. Try a different browser to rule out an extension conflict

docs.title: Community chat not visible
docs.text: Community chats appear inside each network under the Chat tab. If you cannot see the tab, you may not yet be a member of that network — go to All networks and join first.

docs.title: Message shows as deleted
docs.text: Messages that have been removed by their sender show as "This message was deleted". This is expected behaviour and cannot be undone.

docs.title: Forgot your password
docs.text:
1. Go to finerminds.com and click Log in
  2. Click Forgot password?
  3. Enter your email address and click Send reset link
  4. Check your inbox — the link arrives within a few minutes
  5. Check your spam/junk folder if it doesn't appear

The reset link expires after 24 hours. If it has expired, request a new one.

docs.title: Reset email not arriving
docs.text:
• Confirm you are using the email address registered to your account
  • Check spam, junk, and promotions folders
  • Add noreply@finerminds.com (or @mindvalley.com) to your contacts and request another reset

docs.title: Google sign-in not working
docs.text:
• Make sure you are selecting the same Google account used when you first signed up
  • If your browser blocks third-party cookies, allow them for finerminds.com or try a different browser
  • Try signing in via an incognito/private window to rule out a cached session

docs.title: Account not found
docs.text: If you receive "account not found" when entering your email, you may not yet have a Finerminds account. Go to finerminds.com and click Sign up.

docs.title: Stuck on a loading screen after login
docs.text:
1. Clear your browser cache and cookies for finerminds.com
  2. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R / Cmd+Shift+R)
  3. Try a different browser or device

docs.text: Everything related to your Vibrantly account — signing in, managing your profile, and account security.

docs.title: Deleting Your Account
docs.text: Deleting your account permanently removes all your data from Vibrantly — lab reports, meal logs, memories, pages, and chat history. This action cannot be undone.

docs.title: Before you delete
docs.text:
Consider whether you want to:

  • Download your lab reports — go to Lab reports and download any files you want to keep
  • Export a page — open any Page you want to keep and download or export the HTML before deleting

docs.title: How to delete your account
docs.text:
1. Go to Settings from the sidebar.
  2. Open the Account tab.
  3. Find the Delete account option and follow the confirmation steps.

You will be asked to confirm your decision. Your account and all associated data will be permanently deleted.

docs.title: After deletion
docs.text:
• You will be signed out immediately
  • Your email address will be released and can be used to create a new Vibrantly account
  • Deleted data cannot be recovered

If you are having trouble with the product rather than wanting to leave permanently, our Troubleshooting guides may help, or contact Vibrantly support.

docs.title: Password Reset
docs.text: If you have forgotten your password, you can request a reset link by email.

docs.title: How to reset your password
docs.text:
1. Go to the Vibrantly login page and tap Forgot password? (below the sign-in form).
  2. Enter the Email address you used to sign up.
  3. Tap Send reset link.
  4. Check your inbox for an email from Vibrantly with a reset link. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive within a few minutes.
  5. Click the link in the email and set a new password.

The reset link expires after 24 hours. If it has expired, repeat the steps above to request a new one.

docs.title: If you signed up with Google or Apple
docs.text: Accounts created with Google or Apple SSO do not have a Vibrantly password. Sign in using the same provider you used at signup — you do not need a reset link.

docs.title: Still locked out?
docs.text: If you no longer have access to your signup email address, contact Vibrantly support to verify your identity and recover your account.

docs.title: Profile & Settings
docs.text: Go to Settings from the sidebar to manage your account details and preferences.

docs.title: General
docs.text: Setting Notes Display name Shown by Luna and throughout the app. Saves automatically when you click away or press Enter. Email Your login email address Username 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores Locale Used to format dates and numbers Timezone Defaults to auto-detect from your device. Can be set manually. Language English is available; more languages coming soon Sign-in method Shows your connected sign-in method (email or SSO provider)

docs.title: Privacy & Data
docs.text:
Under the Privacy & Data tab:

  • Lab report data is encrypted at rest and de-identified before AI analysis runs
  • Memories are built automatically from your Chat conversations. Ask Luna to discard a specific memory via Chat.
  • Meal logs and lab reports are private to your account
  • Pages you create can be set to Private, Private Link, or Public

docs.title: Connections
docs.text: The Connections tab shows services linked to your account — including any SSO providers (Google, Apple) you connected at signup.

docs.title: Account
docs.text: The Account tab contains actions that affect your account at the account level, including options to close or delete your account. See Deleting Your Account.

docs.title: Signing In
docs.text: Go to vibrantly.com or open the Vibrantly app to sign in.

docs.title: Signing in with email
docs.text:
Vibrantly uses a two-step login — your email and password are entered on separate screens.

  1. Enter your Email address and tap Continue.
  2. Enter your Password and tap Sign in.

docs.title: Signing in with Google or Apple
docs.text: If you created your account with Google or Apple SSO, tap Continue with Google or Continue with Apple on the login screen. You will be redirected to confirm with that provider and returned to your dashboard.

docs.title: Staying signed in
docs.text: Vibrantly keeps you signed in on trusted devices. If you are signed out unexpectedly, this may be due to a session expiry or a recent password change. Simply sign in again.

docs.title: Having trouble?
docs.text:
• Forgot your password → Password Reset
  • Account not recognized → check you are using the email address you signed up with
  • SSO not working → see Login Issues

docs.title: Billing & Plans
docs.text: Your Vibrantly subscription is managed through your account settings.

docs.title: Viewing your plan
docs.text: Your current plan tier is shown next to your name in the sidebar (e.g. Member). For full plan details — including your renewal date and what's included — go to Settings > Account.

docs.title: Upgrading or changing your plan
docs.text: To upgrade your plan or explore available tiers, contact Vibrantly support or visit the billing section within the app on your device. Plan options and pricing are managed through the platform and may vary by region.

docs.title: Cancellation
docs.text: To cancel your subscription, go to Settings > Account and follow the cancellation steps, or contact Vibrantly support. Cancellations take effect at the end of your current billing period — you retain access until then.

docs.title: Refunds
docs.text: Refund eligibility depends on your subscription type and region. Contact Vibrantly support with your account email to request a refund review.

docs.title: Need help?
docs.text: If you have a billing question that is not covered here, contact Vibrantly support directly from within the app or at vibrantly.com.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
Vibrantly's core features, each explained in its own guide.

Feature Description Today View Daily dashboard with meal logging, AI insight, and body summary Meals Log meals via text, photo, or voice — Luna analyzes each one Chat with Luna Free-form conversation with your AI health companion Companion Settings Customize Luna's personality, name, and voice Skills Specialized AI tools that extend what Luna can do Memories Luna's knowledge graph — everything she has learned about you Lab Reports Upload bloodwork and get biomarker analysis Body Signals Your complete biomarker picture, categorized and explained Pages AI-generated health documents you can share or keep private

docs.title: Body Signals
docs.text: The Body view shows your complete biomarker picture — categorized, annotated, and prioritized by Luna based on your uploaded lab reports.

docs.title: Biomarker summary
docs.text: At the top, Luna gives a natural-language summary: what looks strong, what caught her attention, and why.

docs.title: Status labels
docs.text:
Label Meaning Excellent Within the optimal range Borderline On the edge — worth monitoring Needs attention Outside reference range; action likely needed Missing Not found in your uploaded reports

Use the filter buttons (All / Excellent / Borderline / Needs attention / Missing) to focus on what needs your attention.

docs.title: Biomarker categories
docs.text:
Vibrantly groups your biomarkers by body system:

  • Hormonal — Cortisol, Testosterone, Thyroid, DHEA, Estradiol
  • Cardiometabolic — Cholesterol (LDL, HDL), Triglycerides, Blood Sugar, Inflammation
  • Liver Function — ALT, AST, GGT, Bilirubin
  • Kidney Function — Creatinine, Blood Urea
  • Complete Blood Count — Red cells, White cells, Hemoglobin, Platelets
  • Vitamins & Minerals — Vitamin D, B12, Folic Acid, Iron, Zinc, Magnesium
  • Inflammation — CRP (C-Reactive Protein)
  • Autoimmune — Anti-CCP, RA Factor
  • Pancreatic Function — Amylase, Lipase

docs.title: Biological age
docs.text: Based on your latest panel, Vibrantly estimates a biological age — a composite signal of how your body is performing relative to your chronological age. The number updates each time you upload a new report.

docs.title: Connection to meals
docs.text:
Luna cross-references your biomarkers with your meal history. If your glucose patterns show variability, she flags relevant meals in the Today view and explains the connection.

If a biomarker is marked Missing, see Lab Report Issues.

docs.title: Companion Settings
docs.text: Go to My AI in the sidebar to customize how Luna behaves and sounds.

docs.title: Personality
docs.text:
Choose an archetype that sets Luna's overall tone. The default is Sage — measured, thoughtful, and question-led.

You can also configure:

Setting What it controls Voice & Style Rules for how Luna phrases responses (e.g. "speak in short sentences") Anti-Patterns What Luna avoids (by default: lecturing or prescriptive advice) Boundaries Hardcoded rules that always apply (e.g. never give medical advice) Custom Instructions Specific behaviors that override archetype defaults Danger Zone Reset to archetype defaults — removes all custom entries

Changes to personality take effect immediately on the next message.

docs.title: Profile & Voice
docs.text:
Go to the Profile tab within My AI to configure Luna's identity:

  • Companion name — rename Luna to anything you prefer (up to 24 characters)
  • Voice — choose from 8 voices for spoken responses
Voice Character Leda Clear and friendly Aoede Smooth and warm Orus Steady and authoritative Puck Playful and upbeat Kore Firm and grounded Charon Calm and measured Fenrir Confident and direct Zephyr Light and energetic

Tap any voice to preview it, then tap Save changes to apply.

docs.title: Lab Reports
docs.text: Vibrantly reads your bloodwork, extracts biomarker values, and maps them to known reference ranges — explained in plain language.

docs.title: Uploading a report
docs.text:
Go to Lab reports in the sidebar and either drag-and-drop your file or click Upload. Supported formats:

  • PDF (most common from labs and clinics)
  • CSV (data exports)
  • Plain text
  • Photos of printed reports

After upload, Vibrantly processes the report using 3 independent AI models that cross-check each other's findings. Processing typically completes in under 60 seconds.

docs.title: Report statuses
docs.text: Status Meaning Saved Uploaded and stored, analysis pending or not yet triggered Analyzed Fully processed — biomarkers extracted and available in Body

docs.title: Viewing a report's full analysis
docs.text:
Tap View Results on any uploaded report to open a full Your Health Intelligence page with four tabs:

Tab What it shows Overview Key headline metrics (Biological Age, HbA1c, GGT, CRP) and a body-system summary Your Body's Story A narrative interpretation written for a non-clinical reader Key Findings Markers that need attention, with context and recommended actions For Your Doctor A structured summary formatted for sharing with a healthcare provider

docs.title: Sharing a report
docs.text: Each report page can be kept Private, shared via Private Link (anyone with the URL), or made Public. You can also download or export the raw HTML.

docs.title: Privacy
docs.text: Lab report data is encrypted at rest and de-identified before any AI analysis runs. See Privacy & Data for details.

docs.title: Chat with Luna
docs.text: Luna is Vibrantly's built-in AI health companion. Every response is grounded in your actual health data — she is not a general-purpose chatbot.

docs.title: Starting a conversation
docs.text:
Go to Chat in the sidebar to start a free-form conversation. Luna can:

  • Answer questions about your biomarkers in plain English
  • Help you understand the nutritional impact of what you ate
  • Give coaching check-ins on your health goals (e.g. half-marathon training, blood sugar management)
  • Analyze a meal photo or restaurant menu

Your conversation history is stored and accessible from the sidebar — Luna carries context across sessions.

docs.title: What Luna knows
docs.text:
Luna has access to everything you've shared with Vibrantly:

Data How Luna uses it Lab reports Explains your biomarkers, flags patterns, answers "what does this mean?" Meal logs Connects eating patterns to your lab results Goals Frames responses around what you're working toward Memories Carries context from past conversations without you having to repeat yourself Skills Can invoke specialized tools (Food Analyzer, Health Check-in) within a conversation

docs.title: Asking good questions
docs.text:
Luna responds best to specific, contextual questions:

  • "My ferritin came back low — what foods would help?"
  • "I had a big pasta dinner last night — how does that affect my glucose?"
  • "Give me a weekly check-in on my blood sugar goals"

For general conversation and coaching, Luna's default archetype is Sage — thoughtful, question-led, and never prescriptive. You can change this in Companion Settings.

docs.title: Limits
docs.text: Luna will never give medical, legal, or financial advice. If you ask something that falls outside her boundaries, she will acknowledge it and direct you to a qualified professional.

docs.title: Meals
docs.text: Vibrantly tracks every meal you log and connects your eating patterns to your lab results. Logging is conversational — there are no forms to fill out.

docs.title: Meal history
docs.text:
Go to Meals in the sidebar to see your full meal log. Each entry shows:

  • Date and time
  • Meal type (Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner / Snack)
  • Macronutrient breakdown (protein, fiber, carbs, fat, calories)
  • Luna's interpretation of how the meal fits your goals

docs.title: Text (from Today view)
docs.text: Type a description in the Log a meal bar on the Today dashboard — e.g. "Grilled salmon with roasted vegetables and water". Luna parses the description and estimates nutrition automatically.

docs.title: Chat logging (text, photo, or voice)
docs.text: Tap Log meal from the Meals page to open Luna's meal logging panel. This is a chat interface — describe what you ate, upload a photo of the meal, or use voice input. Luna responds with a nutritional breakdown and contextual analysis.

docs.title: Food Analyzer skill
docs.text: Open Chat and invoke the Food Analyzer skill for a structured meal analysis — useful for restaurant meals, menu photos, or detailed nutritional breakdowns.

docs.title: How Luna analyzes meals
docs.text:
For each logged meal, Luna:

  1. Estimates macronutrients based on the description or photo
  2. Checks the meal against your active health goals (e.g. blood sugar management, protein targets)
  3. Cross-references with your latest biomarkers — if glucose variability is flagged in your lab report, she will note relevant meals

docs.title: Meal type classification
docs.text: Meals are automatically classified as Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, or Snack based on the time of logging and context from your description. You can override the classification in the meal log.

docs.title: Memories
docs.text: Memories is Luna's knowledge graph — everything she has learned about you through your conversations.

docs.title: What gets stored
docs.text:
Luna builds memories automatically as you chat with her. Memories are organized as:

Type Examples Objects Specific items — meals, products, supplements, plans Notes Observations from your conversations Topics Recurring themes — nutrition, fitness, sleep, stress Organizations Labs, clinics, or services you've mentioned Goals Active health objectives Luna is tracking

docs.title: Viewing memories
docs.text:
Go to Memories in the sidebar. You can view your memory graph in three layouts:

  • List — a flat, searchable list of all memories
  • Graph — a visual network showing how memories connect
  • Tree — a hierarchical view grouped by type

docs.title: Editing memories
docs.text:
Memories are read-only in the Memories view — Luna builds them automatically. To update or remove a specific memory, ask Luna directly in Chat:

  • "Forget that I'm training for a half-marathon"
  • "Update my goal — I'm now focused on blood sugar, not weight"
  • "I don't take magnesium supplements anymore"

Luna will acknowledge the change and update her knowledge graph accordingly.

docs.title: Pages
docs.text: Pages are AI-generated health documents that Luna creates for you — for example, a plain-English interpretation of a lab report, a personalized nutrition blueprint, or a health summary you can share with a doctor.

docs.title: How pages are created
docs.text:
Luna generates a page when you ask for a report or document in Chat. For example:

  • "Summarize my latest lab results for my doctor"
  • "Create a nutrition plan based on my biomarkers"
  • "Write a health summary I can share with my trainer"

Pages are also created automatically when you tap View Results on a lab report — Vibrantly generates a Your Health Intelligence page for each analyzed report.

docs.title: Visibility settings
docs.text:
Visibility Access Private Only you Private Link Anyone with the URL Public Discoverable by others

You can change a page's visibility at any time from the page itself.

docs.title: Managing pages
docs.text:
Go to Pages in the sidebar to see all your generated documents. From the pages list you can:

  • Open and read any page
  • Change its visibility
  • Download it or export the raw HTML
  • Delete it

Pages are separate from your raw uploaded lab report files — deleting a page does not delete the original lab report.

docs.title: Skills
docs.text: Skills are specialized AI tools that extend what Luna can do in structured, focused ways.

docs.title: Browsing the library
docs.text:
Go to Skills in the sidebar to see the full library — 33 skills at launch, organized by category.

Category Examples Health Menu Analyzer, Food Analyzer, Health Check-in Planning Goal Review, Daily Briefing, Weekly Review Learning Extract Knowledge, Web Reader Writing Note Cleaner, Page Designer, Bio Writer Review Design Review, Page Critic, Watch YouTube Wellness Sleep Coach, Running Plan Builder

docs.title: Using a skill
docs.text:
1. Open Chat to start a conversation with Luna
  2. Open the Skills panel from within Chat and tap the skill you want to use
  3. Luna will activate the skill and guide you through it

Some skills trigger naturally from conversation — if you describe a meal and Luna detects it, she may invoke the Food Analyzer automatically.

docs.title: Creating a custom skill
docs.text: Tap Create in the Skills library to build your own skill. Custom skills follow the same format as built-in ones — you define the trigger, the task, and any output format you want.

docs.title: Today View
docs.text: The Today dashboard is the first thing you see when you open Vibrantly. It combines your daily meal activity, a personalized AI insight, and a snapshot of your body signals.

docs.title: Daily greeting and insight
docs.text: At the top, Luna greets you by name and surfaces the most relevant health insight for the day — based on your lab results, recent meals, and stated goals.

docs.title: Logging a meal
docs.text:
Type a description of what you ate in the Log a meal bar at the top of the page (e.g. "Fried chicken sandwich and black coffee"). Luna will:

  1. Identify the meal and estimate its nutritional breakdown (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber)
  2. Relate it to your current health goals
  3. Show you what the meal means for your body

You can also log meals by photo — open Chat and use the Food Analyzer skill.

docs.title: Today's Insight card
docs.text: Below the meal bar, Luna shows a Today's Insight card — a concise observation based on patterns in your data. This may highlight a trend across your recent meals, a connection between a biomarker and your eating habits, or a forming pattern worth watching.

docs.title: Meals summary
docs.text: The From Your Meals section shows your most recently logged meals with time, meal type, macro breakdown, and Luna's interpretation. Tap See all to go to the full Meals view.

docs.title: Body signals summary
docs.text: The bottom of Today shows a Body Signals snapshot — calories tracked today and key biomarker flags from your latest lab report. Tap any item to go to the full Body Signals view.

docs.title: Getting Started with Vibrantly
docs.text: New to Vibrantly? These guides walk you through the first steps — creating your account, uploading your first lab report, and getting oriented in the dashboard.

docs.title: In this section
docs.text:
• Creating Your Account — sign up with email, Google, or Apple
  • Uploading Your First Lab Report — add your bloodwork and get your first analysis
  • Understanding the Dashboard — what you see when you log in and what to do first

docs.title: Creating Your Account
docs.text: Go to vibrantly.com and tap Get started to create a new account.

docs.title: Signing up with email
docs.text:
1. Enter your Full name and Email address.
  2. Create a Password (minimum 8 characters).
  3. Optionally select how you heard about Vibrantly from the dropdown.
  4. Click Continue.

You will be taken directly into a short onboarding flow to set up your AI companion.

docs.title: Signing up with Google or Apple
docs.text: Below the form, tap Continue with Google or Continue with Apple to create your account without setting a password. You will be redirected to confirm with Google or Apple, then returned to Vibrantly to complete onboarding.

docs.title: Onboarding
docs.text:
After signup, Vibrantly walks you through a short setup:

  1. A few health-context questions about your goals and lifestyle
  2. Naming your AI companion (default: Luna)
  3. Choosing Luna's personality archetype and voice

You can change all companion settings later from My AI in the sidebar.

docs.title: Already have an account?
docs.text: Go to Signing In if you already have an account and need help logging in.

docs.title: Uploading Your First Lab Report
docs.text: Uploading a lab report is the most important first action in Vibrantly — it gives Luna the data she needs to personalize everything else.

docs.title: Supported formats
docs.text: Format Notes PDF Most lab reports from clinics and hospitals CSV Data exports from health platforms Plain text Copied values pasted into a text file Photo A photo of a printed or handwritten report

docs.title: How to upload
docs.text:
1. From the sidebar, tap Lab reports.
  2. Click Upload or drag your file into the upload zone.
  3. Vibrantly processes your report using 3 independent AI models that cross-check each other's findings. This takes under 60 seconds.
  4. When complete, tap Body in the sidebar to view your extracted biomarkers.

Your uploaded reports are listed on the Lab reports page with their file name, date, and status (Saved or Analyzed).

docs.title: Privacy
docs.text: Your report data is encrypted at rest. Before AI analysis runs, all personal identifiers are removed — the models see your biomarker values, not your name or contact details. Vibrantly stores data in compliance with HIPAA standards.

docs.title: What happens after upload
docs.text:
Once your first report is processed, Luna will:

  • Surface a body signals summary on your Today dashboard
  • Generate a plain-English explanation of your key biomarkers in Body
  • Begin cross-referencing your meals with your biomarker patterns

If a biomarker is missing or the report did not parse correctly, see Lab Report Issues.

docs.title: Understanding the Dashboard
docs.text: When you log in, Vibrantly opens on the Today view — your daily health summary.

docs.title: The sidebar
docs.text:
The sidebar is your primary navigation. It is always visible on desktop and accessible from the bottom bar on mobile.

Section What it does Today Daily dashboard — meal bar, AI insight, body signals summary Meals Full meal history and logging Body Biomarker view from your uploaded lab reports Lab reports Upload and manage your health files Chat Talk to Luna, your AI companion Pages AI-generated health documents My AI Customize Luna's personality and voice Skills Browse and use specialized AI tools Memories Luna's knowledge graph about you

docs.title: What to do in your first week
docs.text:
1. Upload a lab report — this unlocks the Body view and personalizes Luna's responses. See Uploading Your First Lab Report.
  2. Log a few meals — open Today and type what you ate in the meal bar at the top of the page.
  3. Chat with Luna — ask her to explain your lab results in plain English, or to help you build a goal around a specific marker.
  4. Browse Skills — find specialized tools for your goals (e.g. Food Analyzer, Health Check-in, Running Plan Builder).

docs.title: The Today view
docs.text:
The top of the Today view shows Luna's daily greeting and a personalized insight based on your latest data. Below that:

  • Meal bar — type a quick meal description to log it
  • Today's Insight card — a pattern Luna noticed in your data
  • From Your Meals — your most recently logged meals with macro breakdowns
  • Body Signals — a snapshot of key biomarker flags from your last report

docs.title: Integrations
docs.text: Connect external apps and devices to enrich your Vibrantly health picture.

docs.title: Available integrations
docs.text: • Apple Health & Wearables — sync activity, heart rate, sleep, and other wearable data

docs.title: Apple Health & Wearables
docs.text: Vibrantly connects to Apple Health and compatible wearable devices to pull in activity, heart rate, sleep, and other signals — giving Luna more data to work with alongside your lab results.

docs.title: Connecting Apple Health
docs.text:
Apple Health integration is set up from the Vibrantly mobile app (iOS). To connect:

  1. Open the Vibrantly app on your iPhone.
  2. Go to Lab reports or My Data from the navigation.
  3. Under Your Connected Apps, tap Apple Health.
  4. Approve the permissions Vibrantly requests — you can grant access to specific data types (Activity, Heart Rate, Sleep, Body Measurements, Nutrition).
  5. Tap Allow to complete the connection.

Once connected, Vibrantly syncs your Apple Health data automatically in the background.

docs.title: What data is synced
docs.text: Data type Used for Activity (steps, workouts) Body signals summary, goal tracking Heart Rate Body signals Sleep Body signals summary Body Measurements (weight, BMI) Biomarker context Nutrition Cross-referenced with meal logs

docs.title: Viewing connected apps
docs.text: On desktop or mobile, go to Lab reports in the sidebar. The Your Connected Apps section shows which integrations are active and their sync status.

docs.title: Disconnecting
docs.text: To disconnect Apple Health, open the Vibrantly app on iOS, go to your Connected Apps, and tap Disconnect next to Apple Health. You can also revoke access from the Health app in iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Health > Vibrantly.

docs.title: Android and other wearables
docs.text: Android support and additional wearable integrations (Garmin, Whoop, Oura) are on the Vibrantly roadmap. Check the My Data page for the latest list of connected app options.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Common issues with Vibrantly and how to fix them.

docs.title: In this section
docs.text:
• Lab Report Issues — report not parsing, missing biomarkers, wrong values
  • Meal Logging Issues — meals not saving, wrong nutrition estimates, Luna not responding
  • Login Issues — can't sign in, SSO errors, account not recognized
  • Luna & Chat Issues — Luna not responding, wrong personality, skill not working

docs.title: Report is stuck in "Saved" and not being analyzed
docs.text:
Processing normally completes in under 60 seconds. If a report stays in Saved status after a few minutes:

  1. Refresh the page and check the status again.
  2. Try re-uploading the file — remove the stuck report and upload a fresh copy.
  3. If the issue persists, the file format may not be fully supported. Try converting your report to a standard PDF and re-uploading.

docs.title: Biomarkers are missing or marked "Missing" in Body view
docs.text:
Missing means a biomarker was not found in your uploaded reports. Common causes:

Cause Fix The test was not included in your panel Upload a more comprehensive report, or accept that this marker is not in your data Vibrantly could not extract the value from the format Try re-uploading as a cleaner PDF or typed text file The report used a non-standard marker name Ask Luna in Chat — she can help identify the equivalent marker

docs.title: Biomarker values look wrong
docs.text:
If an extracted value differs from what is on your lab report:

  1. Open the original report and compare the specific value and unit.
  2. Units matter — a value reported in µmol/L vs mg/dL will look very different as a number.
  3. If the value is genuinely wrong, re-upload a cleaner file (e.g. a higher-resolution scan or a PDF instead of a photo).
  4. You can also ask Luna in Chat: "My ferritin shows X but my report says Y — can you help me understand?"

docs.title: Duplicate reports appearing
docs.text: If you uploaded the same report twice, the duplicate will appear as a separate entry. You can delete the extra copy from the Lab reports list without affecting your biomarker data (the analyzed data from the first upload is retained).

docs.title: Report upload fails
docs.text:
• Confirm the file is under the size limit (most PDFs are fine under 10 MB)
  • Try a different browser or device
  • If uploading a photo, ensure it is well-lit and the text is legible

docs.title: Incorrect email or password
docs.text:
• Double-check the email address — it must match exactly what you used at signup (including any dots or plus signs).
  • Passwords are case-sensitive.
  • If you have forgotten your password, go to Password Reset.

docs.title: "Account not found" error
docs.text:
This usually means the email address is not registered with Vibrantly. Check:

  • Whether you signed up with a different email address
  • Whether you used Google or Apple SSO instead of email at signup — try signing in with those options
  • Whether your account was deleted

docs.title: Google or Apple SSO not working
docs.text:
1. Make sure you are selecting the same provider you used at signup.
  2. If you used Google, ensure you are signed into the correct Google account in your browser.
  3. Try in an incognito window to rule out cached auth state.
  4. If the SSO redirect fails or shows an error, try clearing cookies for the SSO provider's domain and retrying.

docs.title: Account locked or too many attempts
docs.text: If you see a message about too many failed attempts, wait a few minutes before trying again. Vibrantly temporarily limits login attempts after repeated failures.

docs.title: Signed out unexpectedly
docs.text: Sessions expire for security. Simply sign in again. If you are being signed out repeatedly and quickly, this may indicate a browser configuration issue — try a different browser or disabling privacy extensions that block cookies.

docs.title: Can't access the email used for reset
docs.text: If you no longer have access to your signup email address, contact Vibrantly support to verify your identity and recover your account.

docs.title: Luna is not responding or Chat is frozen
docs.text:
1. Refresh the page and try sending your message again.
  2. If the page loads but Luna does not reply after 30 seconds, she may be processing a complex request. Wait briefly then retry.
  3. If Chat consistently fails to load, try a different browser or clear your browser cache.
  4. Check your internet connection — Luna requires a stable connection to respond.

docs.title: Luna's responses feel generic or unhelpful
docs.text:
Luna's quality improves significantly with more data. If her responses seem generic:

  • Upload a lab report — without bloodwork, Luna has limited health context
  • Log more meals — meal history gives Luna pattern data
  • Chat more specifically — instead of "how am I doing?", try "my glucose is elevated — what meals might be contributing?"

Also check that Luna's personality is configured as intended — a reset personality (from Danger Zone in My AI) returns her to archetype defaults, which may feel different.

docs.title: Luna is using the wrong personality or name
docs.text:
If Luna's name or tone changed unexpectedly:

  1. Go to My AI in the sidebar.
  2. Check the Profile tab — confirm the companion name is set as intended.
  3. Check the Personality tab — confirm the archetype and custom instructions are correct.
  4. If you accidentally tapped Reset entire personality, all custom settings were removed. You will need to reconfigure them.

docs.title: A skill is not working
docs.text:
1. Go to Skills in the sidebar and confirm the skill is listed and enabled.
  2. Try invoking the skill directly from the Skills panel in Chat rather than relying on Luna to trigger it automatically.
  3. If a specific skill shows an error, it may be temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.

docs.title: Luna keeps referencing something I told her to forget
docs.text: Ask Luna directly in Chat: "Please remove the memory about [topic]." She will acknowledge the deletion. If the memory reappears, go to Memories in the sidebar, find the entry, and ask Luna again with the exact wording from the memory.

docs.title: Luna is not connecting my meals to my biomarkers
docs.text:
This connection requires both a lab report and meal logs to be present. If you have both:

  1. Confirm your lab report status is Analyzed (not just Saved) in Lab reports.
  2. Check the Body view — if biomarkers are showing as Missing, the report may not have parsed fully. See Lab Report Issues.

docs.title: Meal not saving after I type it
docs.text:
If you typed a meal description and it did not appear in your Meals history:

  1. Check that you pressed Enter or tapped Send to submit — the meal is only logged when you confirm.
  2. Refresh the page and check the Meals list.
  3. If the meal still did not save, try logging it again via the Chat tab using the Log meal flow.

docs.title: Nutrition estimates look wrong
docs.text:
Luna estimates nutrition from your description. The accuracy depends on how specific you are.

Less accurate More accurate "Salad" "Caesar salad with grilled chicken and croutons, about 300g" "Pasta" "One cup cooked spaghetti with tomato sauce and 100g ground beef" "Chicken" "200g grilled chicken breast with salt and pepper"

If Luna's estimate is clearly off, you can ask her to revise it in Chat: "That meal was more like 600 calories — can you update the estimate?"

docs.title: Meal type is wrong (Breakfast logged as Lunch, etc.)
docs.text: Meal type is automatically assigned based on time of logging. If it is wrong, tap the meal in your history and edit the meal type.

docs.title: Luna's chat panel does not open when I tap "Log meal"
docs.text:
1. Try a hard refresh of the page.
  2. If you are on mobile, close and reopen the app.
  3. If the issue persists, log the meal from the Today view meal bar instead — type directly into the input at the top of the page.

docs.title: I logged a meal but it is not showing in Today view
docs.text: The Today view shows only your most recent meals. If you logged a meal earlier in the day, scroll down in the From Your Meals section or tap See all to go to the full Meals history.
